Add Storybook GitHub Pages deploy (#14456)

Adds a manual GitHub Pages deployment workflow for the archived Polaris
React Storybook at https://storybook.polaris.shopify.dev/.\n\nNotes:\n-
Builds the existing archived Storybook from `@shopify/polaris`.\n-
Deploys `polaris-react/build-internal/storybook/static` via GitHub
Pages.\n- Includes `.nojekyll` and a `CNAME` for
`storybook.polaris.shopify.dev`.\n- Uses a filtered pnpm install so the
Storybook build does not need unrelated root dev
dependencies.\n\nImportant Pages caveat:\n- This repository has one
GitHub Pages site. Running this workflow will replace the currently
deployed archived-docs Pages artifact at
`https://shopify.github.io/polaris-react-archive/` with the Storybook
artifact. If we need to preserve both the docs Pages site and host
Storybook at the custom-domain root, we should use a dedicated public
repo for Storybook; I attempted to create
`Shopify/polaris-react-storybook`, but my account does not have org
repository creation permission.\n\nAfter this lands, run the workflow
once, point DNS for `storybook.polaris.shopify.dev` away from Chromatic
and to GitHub Pages, verify, then re-archive the
